english.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese noun for something unimportant, rather than a quantity or a named dessert.
Use this when the trifle is a matter of little importance rather than a physical object.

examples.english: This is just a trifle; there’s no need to get so nervous.
examples.traditional: 呢啲只係小事，唔使咁緊張。
examples.jyutping: ni1 di1 zi2 hai6 siu2 si6 m4 sai2 gam3 gan2 zoeng1

examples.english: This is a toy problem, so don't get so worked up.
examples.traditional: 呢件事係小事，唔使咁緊張。
examples.jyutping: ni1 gin6 si6 hai6 siu2 si6 m4 sai2 gam3 gan2 zoeng1
